title: Nabari no Ou
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Apathetic schoolboy Miharu Rokujou learns that the hidden ninja world's ultimate secret art, a power able to do great good or harm, is sealed inside him. Rival ninja clans try to seize him, and he must take up the ninja path to survive (Yen Press blurb via AniList/MU). Reviews describe a dark, moody psychological drama about secrets and loyalties.
life_message: Even someone who has shut himself off can come to care for others and take responsibility for them.

folkways.japan: Ninja clans tied to historical regions such as Iga draw on Japanese folklore and teacher-student loyalty, described as context.
